Class FakeDirectories

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.platform.testing.FakeDirectories
All Implemented Interfaces:
Directories
public final class FakeDirectories extends Object implements Directories
Directories under one root directory, such as a test's temporary directory, so that code under test never touches the real ones.

By default, each directory is a distinct subdirectory of the root, named after its method:

  • home(): home
  • dataHome(): data-home
  • configHome(): config-home
  • stateHome(): state-home
  • cacheHome(): cache-home
  • runtimeDir(): runtime-dir
  • dataDirs(): one directory, data-dir
  • configDirs(): one directory, config-dir

Distinct directories show when code puts a file in the wrong one, and one directory in each search list shows whether it searches the lists at all. Any directory can be replaced, the same one given for several of them as on Windows and macOS, and the runtime directory removed, as on macOS and Windows.

Like the real ones, the directories are not created unless asked for with FakeDirectories.Builder.createDirectories(boolean): code that writes in them should create them first. 

Directories directories = FakeDirectories.newBuilder(temporaryDirectory).withoutRuntimeDir().build();

  • Method Details

    • newBuilder

      public static FakeDirectories.Builder newBuilder(Path root)
      Returns a builder of directories under a root directory. Every path given to the builder must be absolute and belong to the file system of the root, which can be any file system, such as a ZIP file system.
      Parameters:
      root - the directory under which every directory is placed by default; it need not exist
      Returns:
      a new builder
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if root is not absolute
